data.notes: January 2027 is currently confirmed more through Verbier’s season-long après-ski and DJ residencies than through one-off touring lineups.

events.title: Farinet Après-ski Winter Live Band Residency
events.summary: Farinet Après-ski confirms daily winter opening through 11 April 2027 with live music from 18:00 to 21:00 every day. The venue is one of Verbier’s core après-ski music institutions on Place Centrale.

events.title: Farinet Lounge Bar Winter DJ Nights
events.summary: Farinet Lounge Bar is confirmed open daily for the winter season through 24 April 2027, with DJs from 21:00 and a late-night festive programme. The same page describes the linked South venue becoming one of Verbier’s livelier nightclubs on weekends.

events.title: Le Rouge Winter DJ Programme
events.summary: Le Rouge confirms winter-season public events with a contemporary DJ programme at its restaurant and après-ski venue at the foot of the piste. The venue is listed as open every day from 4 December 2026 to 25 April 2027.

events.title: SOUTH Restaurant & Club Winter Nightclub Season
events.summary: Farinet’s lower-ground-floor SOUTH runs as an intimate restaurant-to-nightclub concept, with music central to the experience and late sessions until 04:00 on Friday and Saturday nights.

events.title: Taratata Festive Late-Night DJ Sets
events.summary: Taratata is confirmed open through 30 April 2027 and describes its winter concept as a tasting-menu restaurant with festive late-night parties and DJ sets. Its listed services include dance, concert and evening entertainment.

events.title: W Living Room Resident DJ Sessions
events.summary: W Verbier’s lounge programme runs through winter with resident DJ mixes in a cocktail-bar setting near Médran, suited to upscale pre-club and late-evening sessions.
